sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the C
 the following:
 Order

T his is the repeat (second) application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No.96/2019 dated (not mentioned) registered at P.S. Shahpur, District Rewa for the offence punishable under Sections 365, 366, 376 (2)(n), 506, 34 IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 17.01.2023.

As per the prosecution, a missing person report was earlier lodged on 28.04.2019 by the father of prosecutrix, later on when she was recovered, she recorded her statement that the present applicant along with other co-accused abducted her from her house and left her with the co-accused Vinay.
It was further alleged that the co-accused Vinay kept her locked inside his house and committed rape with her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution case in her Court statement.
She has retracted her earlier statement given under Section 164.
She has fairly stated that the abduction as well as rape was committed by the co-accused Vinay and has not made any allegation against the present applicant.

Learned counsel for the State though opposed the bail application but fairly submits that the prosecutrix in her Court statement has not supported the prosecution version in respect of present applicant.

Considering that the prosecutrix has retracted her earlier statement given under Section 164 and has not supported the prosecution version, as far as the present applicant is concerned, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
(NANDITA DUBEY) JUDGE b Pappu Yadav @ Rajendra Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023
